title: Parrot (preview)
card: An African Grey whose Cadence brain hears a spoken question from a list and answers in sound. A preview from development.
tagline: A brain that hears and speaks sounds as symbols
kicker: SOUNDS AS SYMBOLS, KEPT IN MEMORY
feature: Each sound the parrot keeps is a record in Cadence's long-term memory, linked to its meaning by synapses. A listed question reaches its ear as a spoken sentence, its trained brain settles on an answer, and the answer brings back its sound.
howTo: Pick a question under Ask it and press Ask. Watch each word light as it is spoken and the answer bring back its sound. Click a thing to put it in focus. Throw a pistachio after a right answer. In Listen to me it says back what it hears.
